title: Raghu Thatha
desc: A wish to fulfil her terminally ill grandfather's last desire and her stance against patriarchy place Kayalvizhi Pandian between conflicting choices, as she struggles to make the right decision.

title: Jai
desc: Jai, a young boy, witnesses the murder of his parents at the hands of their greedy manager. When he grows up, he sets out with his caretaker to avenge the wrongs done to his family.

title: Kaatera
desc: Kaatera, a blacksmith from a village named Bheemanahalli, goes through numerous threats so that a reform act gets implemented which gives freedom to the farmers from feudal landlords.

title: Thavarina Siri
desc: Muttanna bravely navigates life's challenges to provide for his family while staying true to his humanitarian heart. Despite their struggles, he selflessly takes care of others.

title: Bhroona
desc: Some of the villagers chance upon the temporary absence of a woman's husband and physically assault her, unbeknownst to the dire consequence that they would have to face.

title: Sidila Mari
desc: Ganganna and Ranga share a close bond with each other but an accident between them causes Ranga to lose his life. Years later, Ranga's son seeks out Ganganna in order to exact revenge.

title: Aaradhane
desc: A religious leader performs sacred rituals and worships the idol of a Hindu deity while chanting holy hymns to seek divine blessings.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Eradane Maduve
desc: Humiliated by his family and friends after a work suspension, a desperate Vishwanath seeks to save face through a reckless affair. His plan backfires when he discovers his wife has a similar idea.

title: Raju Kannada Medium
desc: Raju, a village boy, travels to Bengaluru in search of a better job. Along the way, he faces numerous challenges that teach him valuable life lessons.
